PC: Did the fellow comprehensively examine the patient? (e.g. assess for delirium using CAM or other tool?)
The fellow created an appropriate treatment plan to treat an acute condition.
The fellow was able to outline measures that could also be taken to assure comfort care.
ICS: Did the physician introduce him/herself to the patient and her son?
Did the patient’s son feel respected by the physician?
Was the patient’s son able to express his mother’s wishes to the physician?
Did the patient’s son understand questions asked by the physician?
Did the patient’s son understand answers given by the physician?
Did the patient’s son feel that he was an active part of the decision making?
Did the fellow comprehensively interview the patient’s son?
The fellow was able to obtain the patient’s wishes through the patient’s son.
The fellow was able to address the patient’s son’s concerns.
The fellow was able to explain the patient’s status and expected prognosis to the patient’s son?
